description: Optional exact prepared-package sources. The default entry reconstructs frozen roles from the pinned Kaggle raw sources in preparation/<dataset>/recipe.json. These null prepared-package entries are not used unless this optional manifest is explicitly selected.

entry_format.url: Replace with a verified public HTTPS URL on port 443 for a flat ZIP containing exactly the three files below.
entry_format.archive_sha256: Replace with the verified 64-character lowercase SHA256 of the exact ZIP bytes.

files.development.npz: Replace with the verified 64-character lowercase SHA256 of this file.
files.preparation.json: Replace with the verified 64-character lowercase SHA256 of this file.
files.selected_train_identities.npz: Replace with the verified 64-character lowercase SHA256 of this file.

constraints: Use the exact ordered feature and class maps in src/dataset_access.py.
development.npz must contain only class_names, feature_names and X/y_train, X/y_cal, X/y_val. TEST and confirmation members are forbidden.
preparation.json must pin data_sha256 and identity_sha256 matching the packaged development and TRAIN identity NPZ files.
Confirm source version, preparation recipe, frozen role identities and redistribution rights before publishing a package or URL.
Raw source CSV downloads alone cannot reproduce this software's frozen development package.
Existing dataset folders are read and validated without replacement; remove or repair an invalid cache explicitly outside this reader.
